title: Everyday Phrases — At the ATM
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏧 實用ATM取款必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the ATM
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用ATM取款情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從找提款機、插卡輸密碼、選金額印收據，到吞卡報錯、查餘額存款與離開安全守則，全程400句。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the ATM phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering finding the machine, entering your PIN, choosing amounts and receipts, card errors, checking balances and safety tips. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ən ˌeɪt i ˈɛm ˈnɪrbi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one is around the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the wall by the side door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə wɔl baɪ ðə saɪd dɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use it late at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz ɪt leɪt ət naɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs all day and night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們現在走過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two people are already in line.
dialogue.zh: 已經有兩個人在排隊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take your place behind them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a line painted on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə laɪn ˈpeɪntɪd ɑn ðə flɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 站在線後面才能保護隱私。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light in the slot blinks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits for a card now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead, slide your card in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the chip facing the right way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tʃɪp ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə raɪt weɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 箭頭朝上、晶片先入，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It slid back out to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it went all the way in.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt wɛnt ɔl ðə weɪ ɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now don't pull it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen jumped to a prompt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 就是你的四位數祕密數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try your birth month and day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type them on the number pad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, shield it with one hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each press shows a small star.
dialogue.zh: 每按一下出現一顆小星號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒人看得到真正的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I hit a wrong key.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在重新輸入那四位數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe zero and eight confused me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, no one saw a thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個人是否在偷看我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Keep your bag in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a camera above the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It protects us, don't mind it.
dialogue.zh: 那是保護我們的，別在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe, the machine won't rush you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the side buttons select lines?
dialogue.zh: 旁邊的按鈕是選行的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press one beside a choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my card come back soon?
dialogue.zh: 我的卡會很快退回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually it returns last of all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌeɪt i ˈɛm sɜrvz ˈæftər ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 提款機下班後照樣服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will anyone come to help me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I do it all myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just follow the on screen hints.
dialogue.zh: 跟著螢幕上的提示做就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it from the top line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, this screen is in English.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep English, I'll read with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's ready for your choices now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So that's how I get cash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I type a number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 數字鍵盤就是用來輸入金額的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which account does money come from?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩個選項：支票或儲蓄帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的工資都進支票帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就點螢幕上的支票帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那儲蓄帳戶是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它幫你留住以後要用的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這次提款只用支票帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 儲蓄裡的錢留著付房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it shows a fee line.
dialogue.zh: 現在出現手續費那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it belongs to another bank.
dialogue.zh: 對，這是別家銀行的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fee added to forty?
dialogue.zh: 手續費會外加在四十上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it comes from the balance.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一張紙為什麼這麼有用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It proves what you took out.
dialogue.zh: 它能證明你領了多少錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I skip the slip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bills will it give me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So forty comes as two notes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩張平整鈔票，沒有別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在這裡大家都領二十面額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it counting my money now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 聽，鈔票在機器裡沙沙響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 電腦最愛這種簡單工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 新鈔票總是慢慢滑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它問還要不要別的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap no on the question box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有自己夠用的時候才選不要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give one dollar if you wish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Polite no, the screen moves on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cash slot just lit green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's curling out of the slot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it till you're home safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tuck it in your wallet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 放進深口袋，別拿在手裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen wants one more tap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 完成會直接結束整個交易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your card should pop right out.
dialogue.zh: 你的卡應該會立刻彈出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 等等，機器會短暫把卡留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab it and check your pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card in again, try a hundred fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɪn əˈɡɛn traɪ ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 卡再插進去，試提一百五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh oh, a red box appeared.
dialogue.zh: 糟了，出現一個紅色視窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a limit or low balance.
dialogue.zh: 可能是限額或餘額不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We just saw the balance though.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A pending charge may block it.
dialogue.zh: 可能有一筆待入帳扣款擋住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That bill is freezing funds now.
dialogue.zh: 那張帳單正凍著你的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那改成少提一點可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it mentions a daily limit.
dialogue.zh: 現在它提到了每日限額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A limit? From my own bank?
dialogue.zh: 限額？是我自己銀行定的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我不記得用過這個額度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你昨天是不是也提過款？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那筆會算進今天的額度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 所以今天領不到更多錢了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks like we're done for now.
dialogue.zh: 看樣子今天就到此為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, it may keep it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfroʊzən ˌeɪt i ˈɛm hoʊldz kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 當機的提款機會扣住卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh great, just what I needed.
dialogue.zh: 噢太好了，正是我需要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 絕不能把卡留在機器上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it and a voice answers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello? My machine ate my card.
dialogue.zh: 喂？我的機器把我的卡吞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks which ATM you use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks wɪtʃ ˌeɪt i ˈɛm ju juz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The number is on the frame.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it slow, twice, to them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll lock that card right now.
dialogue.zh: 他們會馬上鎖住那張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock it? Good, do that fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No one can use your money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They send a text with steps.
dialogue.zh: 他們傳了簡訊附上步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring ID to the home branch.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ˌaɪ ˈdi tə ðə hoʊm bræntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 帶著身分證去往來的分行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they just give it back?
dialogue.zh: 他們不能當場還我卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staff open machines on set days.
dialogue.zh: 員工只在固定日子開箱收卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can still use the app.
dialogue.zh: 你還是可以用手機銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這段時間先用手機支付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See if your card is free.
dialogue.zh: 看看你的卡解脫了沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab it before it pulls back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lock can come off now.
dialogue.zh: 卡拿回來了，鎖定就可以解掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, it proves the error.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它該不會還是扣到我錢了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the app in one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No fee for a failed try?
dialogue.zh: 失敗的嘗試不收手續費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 被拒絕的試領都會退還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你看，有張用膠帶貼的公告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's for the machine next door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out of cash since this morning.
dialogue.zh: 從今天早上就沒現鈔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˌeɪt i ˈɛm wɪˈðaʊt ˈmʌni waʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好在我們這台還亮著綠燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這次跳出一樣的錯誤碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊd i tu ˈziroʊ sɛvn ɡɑt ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps the bank fix things.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們該通知裡面的人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell the guard at the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says staff will come soon.
dialogue.zh: 他說工作人員很快過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wrote your card number too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The grocery store has one inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /stɔr ˌeɪt i ˈɛmz tʃɑrdʒ ˈɛkstrə fiz/
dialogue.zh: 商店裡的提款機手續費更高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least my PIN is safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never share it with the guard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪt i ˈɛmz ˈtitʃ ˈpeɪʃəns fər ʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 提款機確實教會人耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try our bank's main branch.
dialogue.zh: 去我們銀行的總行試試吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks from here, let's go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 到時候重新痛快提一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here at the branch at last.
dialogue.zh: 總算到了我們自己的分行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put your card in once more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The PIN worked on the first try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɪn wɜrkt ɑn ðə fɜrst traɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let me check the balance.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The balance button is right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a second to load.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the slip shows two sums.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上面是餘額，下面是提款數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still need a hundred more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 按下確認，會聽見沙沙聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's asking for a receipt again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slot will flash when ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There they come, one by one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really wish for small bills.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The teller can break big notes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Break them? What does that mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trade one fifty for five tens.
dialogue.zh: 拿一張五十換五張十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 搭計程車給小費最剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, can I deposit a check?
dialogue.zh: 那我能夠存一張支票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign the back first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The check slot looks so small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It scans the face and the sum.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt skænz ðə feɪs ænd ðə sʌm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 和你那張支票完全一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很少會那麼快，銀行得先核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那今天就動不到這筆錢囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the date and account name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're done at this machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, where's my card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finish, and it returns to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hands you the last slip.
dialogue.zh: 它把最後一張單據給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pocket the card and the slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈpɑkɪt ðə kɑrd ænd ðə slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 卡和單據我都收進口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the screen say thank you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It flashed have a nice day.
dialogue.zh: 它閃出祝你有美好一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有個習慣：絕不在外面數錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count at home behind the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 小偷真的會在旁窺視嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So hide the cash, walk calm.
dialogue.zh: 所以要收好錢，從容地走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I look at my phone now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ lʊk æt maɪ foʊn naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait till you're around the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些單據上有機密數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shred them, never toss them whole.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My balance moved inside the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next payday, use my own bank.
dialogue.zh: 下次發薪日就用自家的銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那裡的提款免手續費，記得？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should this code live now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只能存在你腦子裡，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not even in my phone notes?
dialogue.zh: 連手機備忘錄也不行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 駭客最先到備忘錄裡翻，唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 到了轉角覺得安全多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spent less than an hour.
dialogue.zh: 我花的還不到一個鐘頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今天這門課學費是一杯拿鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 下週我就可以自己去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll handle it like a pro.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any last tips for an ATM?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni læst tɪps fər ən ˌeɪt i ˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 關於提款機還有最後祕訣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 印出來的單據一定要拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine are already in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card sleeps in this pocket.
dialogue.zh: 我的卡就睡在這個口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out of sight, safe and sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 三百九十塊能撐一陣子。
